opportunities.title: Research Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; early career researchers are welcome.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural history, material culture studies, and related fields.

opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales and Open Research Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; open to researchers in archaeology and related fields.
opportunities.summary: Awards supporting research archaeology in Wales and open research projects, with applications due annually.

opportunities.title: Beatrice di Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; open to researchers in archaeology, art history and related disciplines.
opportunities.summary: Series of named awards supporting research in archaeology, art history, and related fields, with annual deadline in early April.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; aimed at projects conserving church heritage.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting conservation of churches, with two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).
